title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: applying a registered correction to the printed particulars
content:
## Situation of use and capability

This tool of the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product applies a registered correction request to the printed particulars of an issued transport document and closes that request as completed. One call rewrites exactly one printed particular with the new wording or figure, and marks the correction request that asked for it as completed. No fee is booked by this action, and no new set of originals is issued by it. Afterwards the document shows the corrected particular and the request shows the outcome completed.

## How it is invoked

apply_particular_correction_a24e9121 is an internal tool of the documentation desk. The agent must first unlock it (unlock) and can then call it (call).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| bl_id | Reference number of the transport document to correct, as returned by the transport document lookup | Id text |
| booking_id | Reference number of the booking the document covers, as shown on the transport document record and returned by the booking lookup | Id text |
| request_id | Reference number of the correction request on file for this document, as returned by the documentation service request lookup | Id text |
| corrected_field | The particular being rewritten; it must be the particular named on the correction request | One value from the list below |
| requested_value | The new wording or figure for that particular | Verbatim text |

### Values accepted for corrected_field

| Value | Particular printed on the document |
|---|---|
| consignee_name | The consignee |
| notify_party_name | The notify party |
| cargo_description | The description of goods |
| package_count | The number of packages |
| gross_weight_kg | The gross cargo weight |
| shipper_name | The shipper |
| port_of_discharge | The port of discharge |

### How requested_value is written

The value is copied character for character from the correction request on file, which holds it exactly as the customer supplied it. Every word, digit, space and punctuation mark is kept, with no translation, normalisation, summarising, addition or deletion.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the transport document reference, the particular corrected, the new printed value and the correction request reference now marked completed. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal.

## Contract Q&A

- **Question:** Does applying the correction also book a fee? **Answer:** No. This tool books no fee.
- **Question:** Does it issue a replacement set of originals? **Answer:** No. No new set of originals is issued by this action.
- **Question:** Hypothetically, a correction request on file asks for the notify party to read "Harbour Traders Pte. Ltd." What is passed? **Answer:** corrected_field notify_party_name and requested_value exactly "Harbour Traders Pte. Ltd.", including the full stops, as held on the request.
